description: SKAB provides multivariate sensor experiments from an industrial Internet-of-Things testbed at the Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology. The native Kaggle description specifies motor vibration, current, voltage and temperature, pressure after the water pump, fluid temperature and circulation flow rate. Timestamps and separate anomaly and changepoint labels support evaluation of condition-monitoring algorithms for the water-circulation loop. The described v0.9 corpus has 35 CSV files, while an introductory notice describes 34 datasets with collective anomalies. These source counts are retained without asserting the number of normal-only runs. Coverage is the controlled testbed; exact acquisition dates and experiment durations are not stated. The provider links to a GitHub repository and registers a version DOI. A planned larger v1.0 release in an old notice is not treated as available data. Reuse terms conflict: the description displays GPL 3.0 while the Kaggle licence field says AGPL 3.0. Cost and payload access remain unknown. No dataset, notebook, README or paper body was fetched.
